flows.name: english-errors
flows.notes: The four required checks pass in both languages (wrong password, 'a:b' folder, fake update zip, vanished file in preview), Thai and English, with the browser locale set to the other language. FAIL because of one more case: on the English page, the row menu 'Download' for a file that no longer exists sends the whole tab to /api/download?space=home&path=%2Fgone2.txt; the user leaves the app and sees raw JSON in the BROWSER's language ({"error":"ไม่พบรายการที่ระบุ","code":"request.not-found"}) because a plain link carries no x-lang. Screenshot english-errors-download-vanished-file.png. Notes: /files?path=/no-such-folder quietly goes back to Home with no message; a synthetic DataTransfer drop is not picked up by n-upload-dragger so the chooser was used.
